events.name: Bash
events.head: Run the start-endy probe and list Instantly references in cloud/src
events.input: $ node cloud/scripts/probe-no-instantly-endy.mjs 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "exit=$?"; echo ---; grep -rn -i "instantly" cloud/src | head -30; echo ---; git status --short -- cloud/src workshop-plan/ops/endy_leads.py workshop-plan/ops/endy-call-brief.md cloud/scripts/probe-no-instantly-endy.mjs; git rev-list --left-right --count origin/main...main; echo ---; wc -l workshop-plan/ops/endy_leads.py workshop-plan/ops/endy-call-brief.md cloud/scripts/probe-no-instantly-endy.mjs

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check push state, hand-off wiring, scheduled job, stale references and the Nelbin task
events.input: $ echo "== pushed?"; git branch -r --contains 80878cb | head -3; echo "== callers"; grep -n "endy_leads\|main_send\|Inbox Partner" workshop-plan/ops/centre_sheet.py | head -20; echo "== importers of instantly connector"; grep -rn "connectors/instantly\|from \"./instantly\"\|inMailboxes\|inWarm" cloud/src --include=*.ts -l | head; echo "== stale team inbox"; grep -rn "adi@growthclub.org" workshop-plan/ops/*.py workshop-plan/ops/*.md workshop-plan/ops/launchd 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rn -i "endy" --include=*.md workshop-plan/ops scripts/walkthroughs/REVERT_LEDGER.md | grep -v endy-call-brief |

events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate the start-endy wait code in the Worker source
events.input: $ grep -n "tantraMailboxes\|Connected and Gmail capable\|start-endy\|start_endy" cloud/src/agentic.ts cloud/src/jobs.ts cloud/src/jobs-m365.ts cloud/src/connectors/stack.ts | cut -c1-240 | head -40

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the start-endy wait, the accounts reader, the sync caller and the job log
events.input: $ sed -n 548,580p cloud/src/jobs.ts | cut -c1-330; echo "== stack"; sed -n 640,662p cloud/src/connectors/stack.ts | cut -c1-300; echo "== agentic endy"; grep -n -i "endy\|warmup\|mail_source\|MAIL_" cloud/src/agentic.ts | cut -c1-260 | head -30; echo "== sheet"; sed -n 228,246p workshop-plan/ops/centre_sheet.py; echo "== log"; tail -6 /tmp/centre-sheet.log | cut -c1-200; echo "== importers"; grep -rln "connectors/instantly" cloud/src; echo "== stale inbox"; grep -rn "adi@growthclub.org" workshop-plan/ops | grep -i -v "dryrun" | cut -c1-200 | head; echo "== docs"; grep -rn -i "endy_leads\|ENDY_

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read how lead rows are built, the sent ledger, the runbook lines and the simulator accounts route
events.input: $ sed -n 158,173p workshop-plan/ops/centre_sheet.py | cut -c1-260; grep -n "^def when" -A4 workshop-plan/ops/centre_sheet.py; grep -n "^def write" -A12 workshop-plan/ops/centre_sheet.py | cut -c1-200; echo "== ledger"; ls -la ~/.config/tantra/ | grep -i endy; cat ~/.config/tantra/endy_leads_sent.json 2>/dev/null | head -c 300; echo; echo "== runbook"; grep -n -i "endy\|centre-sheet\|centre_sheet" workshop-plan/ops/runbook.md | cut -c1-400; echo "== sim accounts"; grep -rn "/accounts" cloud/sim 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-220 | head -8; ls cloud | head -30; echo "== interval"; grep -n -A1 "StartInter

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read runbook status lines, find simulator account routes and probes covering start-endy, and read the card
events.input: $ sed -n 6,12p workshop-plan/ops/runbook.md | cut -c1-500; sed -n 45,49p workshop-plan/ops/runbook.md | cut -c1-500; echo "== sim"; grep -rl "gmail_capable\|\"/accounts\|/accounts" app/scripts/*.mjs cloud/scripts/*.mjs app/sim 2>/dev/null | head -8; grep -rln "start-endy" app/scripts cloud/scripts 2>/dev/null | head -8; ls cloud/node_modules/.bin | grep -c "^tsx$\|^esbuild$"; echo "== card"; grep -n "start-endy" -A14 app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts | cut -c1-330 | head -24

events.name: Bash
events.head: Fix the dedupe key and the stale runbook line, then run a local fake-service test of the hand-off and a real dry run

events.name: Bash
events.head: Save the hand-off test in the repo, re-run test and probe, inspect uncommitted diffs, check push state, and arm the approved scheduled test
events.input:
$ sed -e 's|sys.path.insert(0, "workshop-plan/ops")|sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent))|' -e 's|^"""Local proof.*|"""T-213: proof of endy_leads.main_send with fake Sheets and Gmail (nothing leaves the machine).

  python3 workshop-plan/ops/test_endy_leads.py
"""|' /tmp/t213_fake.py > workshop-plan/ops/test_endy_leads.py

events.name: Bash
events.head: Wait for the next scheduled sync to run the armed test and show its log lines
events.input: $ until grep -q "test row removed" <(tail -n 12 /tmp/centre-sheet.log) && [ ! -e ~/.config/tantra/endy_test_armed ]; do sleep 20; done; tail -n 8 /tmp/centre-sheet.log | cut -c1-200

events.name: Bash
events.head: Scan the changed files for long dashes and view the revert ledger format
events.input: $ grep -nP "[\x{2013}\x{2014}]" workshop-plan/ops/endy-call-brief.md workshop-plan/ops/endy_leads.py workshop-plan/ops/test_endy_leads.py | head -3; echo "dashes checked"; grep -n "endy" scripts/walkthroughs/REVERT_LEDGER.md | cut -c1-400; head -8 scripts/walkthroughs/REVERT_LEDGER.md | cut -c1-200

events.name: Bash
events.head: Count long dashes in the changed files and check on the armed test

events.name: Bash
events.head: Commit the four T-213 files
events.input: $ P="workshop-plan/ops/endy_leads.py workshop-plan/ops/test_endy_leads.py workshop-plan/ops/runbook.md workshop-plan/ops/endy-call-brief.md" && git add -- ${=P} && git commit -q -m "Agent T-213: verify pass, a lead is mailed once per email address (an edited row is not resent), hand-off test with fake Sheets and Gmail, stale runbook warning and brief wording fixed

events.text: Fixes are committed (6a59a78); I'm now waiting for the 06:56 scheduled sync to run the armed test unaided, then I'll log it and close out the task.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check whether the scheduled sync has run the armed test
events.input: $ cat /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-adithyamurali-tantra-redesign/bcf32fc4-cd9a-4925-a35c-16d43343bdc6/tasks/b6j1k1yhv.output | cut -c1-200; echo "--"; date; ls ~/.config/tantra/ | grep endy; tail -n 6 /tmp/centre-sheet.log | cut -c1-160

events.name: Bash
events.head: Wait for the scheduled sync to finish the armed test and show its log
events.input: $ until [ ! -e ~/.config/tantra/endy_test_armed ] && tail -n 6 /tmp/centre-sheet.log | grep -q "test row removed"; do sleep 10; done; date; tail -n 6 /tmp/centre-sheet.log | cut -c1-160
